description: Image Description: The image shows a row of parking meters displayed on a wooden shelf against a wall. There are ten parking meters in total, each mounted on a metallic base and varying slightly in design and color. Most of the meters are black, but a few have colored tops—orange, green, red, and blue—possibly indicating different functions or time limits. One meter has a white sign attached to it that reads "15 min." in red text, suggesting a time limit for parking.
